title: Hello Harmozi
name: HelloHarmozi
author: Carmelo Santana
description: A random Alex Hormozi quote in your footer. A Hello Dolly homage.

title: ModMenu
name: ModMenu
author: Carmelo Santana
description: A standalone plugin manager: browse, install, upload, enable/disable, update, and uninstall Kanboard plugins, with a dependency system. Updates itself with one click (verified, staged swap with rollback).

title: ModMenu Updater
name: ModMenuUpdater
author: Carmelo Santana
description: One-shot helper: upgrades ModMenu older than 1.3.0 to the self-updating version, then can be removed.

requires.reason: Uses ModMenu's directory sources and archive checks.

title: Shadcn Theme
name: ShadcnTheme
author: Carmelo Santana
description: Modern Kanboard theme inspired by shadcn/ui design principles with light/dark mode toggle and system preference detection.

recommends.reason: site logo, favicon and name

deprecated.reason: Harbor is ShadcnTheme's successor: the same look, a no-flash theme and the suite UI kit.

title: Harbor
name: Harbor
author: Carmelo Santana
description: The suite's flagship theme and UI kit, succeeding Shadcn Theme: Newburgh and Shadcn presets in light and dark, no flash on load, a floating sign-in page and a subtask status menu.

recommends.reason: layout wrappers stack (Harbor D7)

title: Bulk Project Delete
name: BulkProjectDelete
author: Carmelo Santana
description: Bulk-delete multiple projects in one action.

title: Feature Sync
name: FeatureSync
author: Carmelo Santana
description: Bulk-copy project features (actions, tags, columns, categories, swimlanes) from a source project to many target projects, with add-missing and replace modes and a read-only diff preview.

title: AI Connector
name: AiConnector
author: Carmelo Santana
description: Universal multi-provider AI backend (built on php-agents): configure named provider profiles (Anthropic, OpenAI, Grok, Gemini, Mistral, Ollama), pick a default, and switch on the fly. Exposes a shared PHP API other plugins consume, including model context-window discovery and token estimation (ModelCatalog), and shared AI limits (a per-person hourly quota and a longest-request cap) every consuming plugin checks before each request, and model routing: a profile per plugin, feature and project, with one shared picker.

title: Subtask Generator
name: SubtaskGenerator
author: Carmelo Santana
description: Generate subtasks from a task description using AI. The provider backend (Anthropic, OpenAI, Grok, Gemini, Mistral, Ollama) is supplied by the AiConnector plugin, with a point-of-use provider picker.

title: Calendar
name: CalendarPlugin
author: Carmelo Santana
description: Drag-and-drop calendar view: tasks by due date, across all projects or per project. Month, week, day, and agenda views, an unscheduled sidebar, filters, and overdue highlighting. Plugins can contribute their own events via the calendarEventSources hook.

title: Dependency
name: DependencyPlugin
author: Carmelo Santana
description: Task dependencies built on core task links: blocked/blocker badges on board cards, calendar events, and the task page, plus a cycle guard. Calendar badges require CalendarPlugin >= 1.1.0.

recommends.reason: adds blocked/blocker badges on calendar events

title: Scheduler
name: SchedulerPlugin
author: Carmelo Santana
description: Automatically rolls overdue tasks forward on a daily sweep, per opt-in project: working-days and de-clump policies, skip-blocked (DependencyPlugin), audit log, per-run activity summary, and a calendar auto-moved badge. Calendar badge requires CalendarPlugin >= 1.1.0.

recommends.reason: shows the auto-moved badge on calendar events
lets the scheduler skip blocked tasks

title: Kensho
name: Kensho
author: Carmelo Santana
description: A private, per-user reflection companion: mine your own Kanboard activity, record who you want to be, and reflect on whether the two align — with an LLM (via AiConnector) as a collaborator, never an authority. Works fully manually without AI.

recommends.reason: AI-assisted area proposal, goal clarification, and reflective narrative (Kensho works fully manually without it)
themed styling via the kbx-* primitives

title: Time Block
name: TimeBlock
author: Carmelo Santana
description: Give a task one planned start+end time block — distinct from its due date — shown on the task page and board card, and contributed to CalendarPlugin's week/day time-grid views.

recommends.reason: renders time blocks on the calendar week/day views

title: TimeReport
name: TimeReport
author: Carmelo Santana
description: Consultant hours reporting plus progress: subtask and time meters on board cards, project and milestone progress, and XP with levels. Pick a project and date range, choose breakdowns, optionally add an AI summary, copy as Markdown or export CSV.

recommends.reason: adds an AI narrative summary of the completed work (the report works fully without it)
adds party XP totals: an owner's level includes their agents' work (progress works fully without it)

title: TimeInvoice
name: TimeInvoice
author: Carmelo Santana
description: Generate polished PDF invoices from your TimeReport hours: pick a project and date range, roll up line items by task, day or week, set rate and tax, and track invoices through draft, issued and paid with stable per-year numbering. Per-project rates, client details and payment terms, an invoice page with inline PDF, and live totals as you draft.

requires.reason: supplies the deduped, correctly-attributed hours aggregate (report()) and breakdown[].task_ids used for invoice line items and AI cover-note context

recommends.reason: optional AI cover-note generation via ProviderRegistry (structured output), ModelCatalog (context-window sizing) and AiQuota (the shared AI limits); the feature is hidden when absent or older

title: Agents
name: Agents
author: Carmelo Santana
description: Provision API-only agent users that drive Kanboard via MCP, and see their work in progress: ranked WIP flags, one-click fixes, and the getWipFlags/applyWipFix API.

title: Battle Lobby
name: BattleLobby
author: Carmelo Santana
description: Battle-royale lobby theme for Kanboard: original characters, rarity-tier cards, storm due dates, READY UP and a victory screen. Fan-made; not affiliated with any game publisher.

recommends.reason: adds subtask progress and XP; Battle Lobby will theme them in a later release (the theme works fully without it)

title: Presence
name: Presence
author: Carmelo Santana
description: See which project members are online, away or offline — with agent users badged as bots. Privacy-first: opt-out per user, admin off switch, no activity history.

recommends.reason: badges agent users as bots and lights them on their JSON-RPC calls

title: Chicane
name: Chicane
author: Carmelo Santana
description: Watch a project as a race track: each task is a corner, a task with subtasks is a chicane, and the cars are the people working on them. Finished road is paved; stalled work leaves hazards. Private by default, with optional share links.

recommends.reason: shows which project members are online beside the track
badges agent-driven cars as bots
adds a level and XP plate to each car from time tracked in the window
a UI for managing core "is blocked by" links; the track reads those links and puts a barrier on blocked work either way

title: BigBoard
name: Bigboard
author: Carmelo Santana
description: Several project boards on one page: pick projects, search across them, fold one away, and drag a task from one project's board into another's. Only shows projects you can access. A maintained fork of the original BigBoard plugin.

title: Pulse
name: Pulse
author: Carmelo Santana
description: A GitHub-style activity heatmap for you, your agents and your projects, coloured by person, type or project. Respects project permissions; managers see their project's members.

recommends.reason: shows your agents' graphs next to yours
counts manually entered time as time logged

title: Resend
name: Resend
author: Carmelo Santana
description: Sends all Kanboard email through the Resend HTTP API. Admins set the API key, which is never shown again after saving, plus an optional sender on a Settings page, then choose resend as the email transport.

title: Agent Chat
name: AgentChat
author: Carmelo Santana
description: A chat room for every project, with an optional project bot that answers from the project's tasks, comments and knowledge base, citing its sources, and an ask-the-bot drawer on each task. People chat works on its own; the bot needs AiConnector.

recommends.reason: Project bot answers
Agent badges

title: Steward
name: Steward
author: Carmelo Santana
description: Admin tools for Kanboard: view Kanboard as another user with an audit log, site branding, safer Markdown with task lists, highlighting and Mermaid, project home and public pages, a test email button and an announcement banner. Each feature has its own switch.

recommends.reason: a working email transport for the test-email button

title: Vault
name: Vault
author: Carmelo Santana
description: Encrypted password store for Kanboard: per-user keys behind a separate vault passphrase, shared groups, agent access, one-time share links and KeePassXC import/export.

recommends.reason: creates the agent users that Vault lets read granted entries through the API

title: LAN Party
name: LanParty
author: Carmelo Santana
description: A game launcher for your team with four original browser games, best-per-player leaderboards, saves and challenge links. Games run sandboxed, and other plugins can add their own.

recommends.reason: keeps agent users off the leaderboards

title: Deed
name: Deed
author: Carmelo Santana
description: Track domain registrations through public RDAP: a watchlist with registrar and expiry, one renewal task per domain per expiry cycle, DNS records, change history and IP/ASN lookups.

title: Windowsill
name: Windowsill
author: Carmelo Santana
description: A per-user weather widget on the Kanboard dashboard: current conditions and a three-day forecast from Open-Meteo, with a place search and metric or US units in your profile.

title: Gumshoe
name: Gumshoe
author: Carmelo Santana
description: Watch GitHub lockfiles for vulnerable dependencies and malware, and track findings in Kanboard.

requires.reason: Holds GitHub tokens with Server sharing enabled. Gumshoe stores only Vault references.

recommends.reason: Runs Gumshoe scans on a schedule.
Suite design system the Gumshoe pages are styled with; core styles are used without it.

title: Foreman
name: Foreman
author: Carmelo Santana
description: Foreman is one small plugin that runs every suite job from one crontab line.

recommends.reason: Provides shared styles for the Jobs page.

title: Switchboard
name: Switchboard
author: Carmelo Santana
description: Command palette for Kanboard: press Ctrl/⌘+K to find and run any action, with commands and search added by plugins.

recommends.reason: uses Harbor's tokens and dialog styling when installed

title: Hot Dog Press
name: HotDogPress
author: Carmelo Santana
description: Make a single-sheet, eight-page zine and print it at home.

title: Broadside
name: Broadside
author: Carmelo Santana
description: Per-project artifacts for Kanboard: any AI agent publishes sandboxed HTML and Markdown pages on the suite's design tokens.

recommends.reason: tokens and theme for artifact pages
rewrites non-conforming imports onto the contract
